note: Re-judged 2026-11-14 by an independent auditor who authored neither 08fe903803 nor the uncommitted phase 2 of spec-single-owner-lifecycle-2-bgp-session. RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 (Idle) read: "In response to a ManualStart event (Event 1) or an AutomaticStart event (Event 3), the local system: - initializes all BGP resources for the peer connection, - sets ConnectRetryCounter to zero". Only the cited producer peer_run.go::runOnce changed (08fe903803): its teardown defer now joins the session's initial sync (session.endInitialSync) and clears establishedSession instead of resetting Peer flags, and enterEstablished and startInitialRoutes take the session. The start selection is byte-identical (reachedEstablished := p.cycleReachedEstablished.Swap(false); start := session.startDamped; start = session.startAutomatic on a reached-Established cycle; session.Start on the first operator start), now at peer_run.go:488-495, so the event fired per cycle is unchanged. The tagged units and fsm.go handleIdle are byte-identical; their shared helper automaticStartInitialEOR now waits for the current session's sync gate to open (nil session keeps polling) where it read the Peer flag, the same wait on the state's new owner. The two mutant records move from lines 438/441 to 489/492 and are retaken with the same sealed text. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. Re-judged 2026-11-06 by an independent auditor who authored none of the changes named; no test or record ran for this judgement. RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 (Idle): "In response to a ManualStart event (Event 1) or an AutomaticStart event (Event 3), the local system: - initializes all BGP resources for the peer connection, - sets ConnectRetryCounter to zero". runOnce changed in 1e65b6d4bb: its only hunk replaces the egressRouteFilter closure with p.egressGate(session), which touches neither cycleReachedEstablished, operatorStarted nor the start selection and moves that selection up two lines (peer_run.go:438 and :441). The tagged test files and fsm.go show no diff since the verdict's commit. Peer units read: exactly 0 once the next connection dials after an Established session, by Cease and by real HoldTimer expiry, and exactly 1 kept after a cycle that never reached Established, including one following an earlier Established cycle, so a start event fired on every cycle, on none, or from an uncleared flag goes red. The record file is retaken: mutants at lines 438 and 441 match the current source, and the runOnce whole-body revert proves reach only. Bound on question 4: the row also holds "initializes all BGP resources", which the RFC does not enumerate; no unit lists resources, and its only observation here is that the next cycle dials or accepts. Sibling RFC4271-8.2.2-7 judges the same clause for Event 1. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
